description: List a domain's email hosting mailboxes (real inboxes at the domain, read over IMAP/POP or webmail), with `status`, `address`, whether each is the free `trial`, and `expires`. A mailbox with `status: PENDINGSETUP` and `address: null` is already paid for, or is the free trial mailbox every domain registration includes: `setup_mailbox` gives it an address for free. Each mailbox also shows `autoRenews` and its `renewalPrice` (`renew_mailbox` adds a year now). Also returns the `price` of buying another mailbox and the mail client settings.
name: list_mailboxes
title: List Mailboxes
